notes: stamped or inked, no separators; four evenly spaced figures, the last with two closed counters so an 8, not a 6. Parsed 1.4.28 on the two-digit-year convention of the other rolls, but 14.2.8 is possible. Two illegible strokes and a comma-like mark stand to the left of the figures. Crop 3 carries a faint pencil number, perhaps 332 4, and crops 2-3 a long pencil line; neither is a date.

stamped, no separators; all five figures plain, the last with a single counter so a 6. Parsed 25.1.26 on the pattern of 14114 = 14.1.1914; 25.12.6 would need a one-figure year. The same two horizontal strokes and comma-like mark stand to the left of the figures as on sx275gw8801, so they seem to belong to the stamp.

stamped across the roll, upright in the upper panel, smudged and seemingly struck twice. The second figure carries a diagonal and a crossbar, so a 4 rather than the 1 of the third figure; the fourth is a 0 with a stray hooked stroke above it. The closing 5 is inked only along its top bar and stem.
stamped, upright in the lower panel; all six figures plain, the 7 with a German crossbar. Same stamp face as xr433hz5827.

stamped in a lighter, unevenly inked face, upright in the upper panel. The first and fifth figures are the same character, a closed curl with a tail running down to the left and no base stroke, which taken alone would read as a 9; read as 2, since 911195 gives neither a day nor a year while 211125 gives 21.11.25. The three 1s and the closing 5 are plain. Crop 2 carries a pencilled 5436, crop 3 only a crease.

stamped, running down the roll at about sixty degrees, upright in the lower panel after rotation. A heavily inked mark, a vertical with two bars projecting to the right and a detached blob below it, stands before five plain figures, 1 8 1 2 8. The same mark, down to the detached blob, precedes the figures on rd899zb5188 and jd143sb1087 in batch 32, and on none of the three can it be read as a figure without destroying the date, so I take it for a fixed slug rather than a digit. Five figures with the leading zeros dropped give 18.1.28. Later than the 1904-1926 span reading.md reports, as is md908xy8241.
